query:
SELECT tu.user_id
                FROM crm_contacts ct
                LEFT JOIN crm_companies c ON c.id = ct.company_id
                JOIN team_user tu ON tu.team_id = ct.team_id
                WHERE ct.id = $1
                  AND (NOT (ct.hidden OR COALESCE(c.hidden, FALSE)) OR tu.team_role <> 'member')
